title: 第十五章 大吉第十六章 娘
content_zh:
她下意识警惕观察四周，根据之前的探查，四周未见有埋伏迹象，越发感到蹊跷，又看向了手中的乾坤袋，更加意识到有人可能不仅是在等着人带出此物，也许还在等着看是什么人会在放行检查时“走眼”，放任此物被人带出去。
她越想越是后背发凉，若非巴应山告知了内情，自己铁定要将此物带走的。
此时自然是如同拿到了烫手山芋，当即转身将乾坤袋塞回了弟弟冰凉的手中，再次打量了一下四周，旋即快速离去。
没等太久，巴应山带着几十号人呼啦啦赶到了，找到事发地，勘察现场，几具死尸不消说，重点是探挖坍塌的矿洞。
一直忙到天亮时分，巴应山才带了部分人先返回了执徐城禀报。
之后，内城空旷场地上，一群人将乾坤袋内取出的龙骨就地拼装。上面有话，这副龙骨要以盘龙状搭好固定，以后就放在这里做执徐城的标志性摆设。
场地边，最高的阁楼上，那名身罩紫罗兰色纱衣的男人负手在一扇窗后，眸光平静，盯着下面场地上搭建的骨龙。
在他边上，是一名气魄雄浑、体态健硕、方面大耳的青衣汉子，目含虎威，开阖间绽露精芒，正是流放之地的巡狱使，杜火官。
杜火官陪同恭敬的意味明显，只因那人就是传说中的生狱执掌者，名字只有一个“聂”字，人称“牢头”。
两人盯着骨龙的搭建，一声不吭。
巴应山带着几个人来到客院厢房敲响了门。
门开，门后的祁月如露面，像是什么事情都没有发生过一般，脸上还带了微笑，“巴城主，可是我弟弟他们找到了？”
巴应山心中暗赞一声，神情凝重地微微点头，伸手邀请状，“申夫人，请跟我来。”
祁月如含笑应允，跟了一行离去。
兜兜转转到了一处屋外，要进门时，巴应山侧身在门口让路，再次郑重道：“申夫人，请节哀。”
一听这话，祁月如顿脸色大变，匆忙跑进了屋内，很快，屋里便响起了她嚎啕大哭的声音。
陆续入内者，见到祁月如抱着儿子尸身伤心欲绝，皆唏嘘不已，跑来探监，本是好事，谁知却变成了送终，还真是世事无常啊！
等了那么一阵后，巴应山方对身后众人道：“生离死别，人之常情，你们都退下吧，先让她发泄发泄再说。”
众人遵应了离去。
没了外人，巴应山走到了祁月如边上，这次是真心劝道：“节哀。”

虽然人家的儿子和弟弟死了，可他心情却轻松了不少，不管人家昨晚跑去咋处理了一趟，反正确实没给他带来什么麻烦，不但把儿子和弟弟的尸首留下了，还有那乾坤袋和骨龙也一并留在了现场，他在现场看到东西回味过来后也惊出了一身冷汗，倒觉得这女人还是懂事的。
哀痛不已的祁月如哽咽着问了声，“查出了什么吗？有没有凶手的线索？”
巴应山扫了眼放一排的尸首，“矿洞里中毒后被埋的人不算，目前还在清理中，就你弟弟这五人，都是被斩首的，仅凭此想找出凶手不易，不过经过仔细勘察伤口，有了大概的论断，他们五个的脑袋应该都是被人用刀砍下来的，综合来看，有可能是同一个刀手所为，现场痕迹也证明了打斗的人不多。”
“刀？”抱伏在儿子尸身上的祁月如猛然抬头，想起了什么似的，“刀砍的？我想起来了，我儿子在东九原好像有个仇家，就是用刀的。”
巴应山有些无奈道：“我知道你说的是谁，你们弄那么多物资进来后不久，东九原的人就刚好得到了一笔物资，你儿子跟那个地头蛇的恩怨，在你们找到我时，我就上心做了解。
据实而论，应该不是那地头蛇干的，从现场勘察来看，你弟弟他们动用了至少两张三品定身符都未能定住对方，这可不是东九原那地头蛇的区区修为能做到的。
矿洞里死的那些人，你别说你不知道是怎么回事，东九原的人基本走光了，依你弟弟他们的阵势，你告诉我，那地头蛇得吃错了多少药才会跑去杀你弟弟他们？就那帮穷疯了的家伙，杀了人还留着宝物不拿，你觉得可能吗？”
言之有理，祁月如也陷入了思索，旋即又一脸泪光道：“帮我查一下他们事发时在哪。”
巴应山本能的想拒绝，然对上她满脸的泪痕和哭红的眼，知道这女人情绪不稳，激怒了还不知会干出什么事来，只能是默然点头答应了，心想着随便走个过场就好。
然现实是，结果得来的有点出乎意料的顺利，他暗中安排去的人，当天下午就带回了可靠消息。
他也没想到申尤昆居然在目标老巢附近还安插了眼线盯梢，刚好被他派去的人发现了，拿下一问，什么都招了，他们可以证明东九原仅剩的两个地头蛇事发时没有离开老巢，据说一直呆在老巢修炼。
按理说有了证人，祁月如应该放心了，然其又有了新的疑惑，拥有了足够的功德，为什么不离开流放之地，仅剩两人还躲在那鸟不拉屎的地方修炼，难道不值得怀疑吗？
content_en:
She subconsciously observed her surroundings vigilantly. According to her previous exploration, there were no signs of an ambush around her. She felt more and more suspicious. She looked at the Qiankun bag in her hand, and realized that someone might not only be waiting for someone to take this object out, but maybe also waiting to see who would "make a mistake" during the inspection and allow this object to be taken out.
The more she thought about it, the more chills ran down her back. If Ba Yingshan hadn't told the inside story, she would have definitely taken this thing away.
Naturally, it was as if he had gotten a hot potato at this time. He immediately turned around and stuffed the Qiankun bag back into his brother's cold hands, looked around again, and left quickly.
Without waiting for too long, Bayingshan arrived with dozens of people. They found the place where the incident occurred and surveyed the scene. Needless to say, there were several dead bodies. The focus was on exploring the collapsed mine.
After being busy until dawn, Bayingshan took some people back to Zhixucheng to report.
Afterwards, in an open space in the inner city, a group of people assembled the dragon bones taken out of the Qiankun Bag on the spot. It is said above that this keel should be set up and fixed in the shape of a coiled dragon, and it will be placed here as the iconic decoration of Zhixucheng in the future.
At the edge of the field, in the highest attic, the man wearing a violet gauze garment had his hands behind a window, his eyes calm, staring at the bone dragon built on the field below.
Next to him is a man in green clothes with a strong spirit, a strong body, and big ears. His eyes are full of tiger power, and his eyes are open and closed. He is the prison patrol officer of the place of exile, Du Huoguan.
Du Huoguan accompanied him with a clear sense of respect, because that person was the legendary leader of the prison. His name only had the character "Nie" and he was known as "Prison Leader".
The two of them stared at the construction of the bone dragon without saying a word.
Bayingshan took several people to the guest room and knocked on the door.
The door opened, and Qi Yueru appeared behind the door, as if nothing had happened, with a smile on his face, "City Lord Ba, have they found my brother?"
Bayingshan secretly praised in his heart, nodded slightly with a solemn expression, stretched out his hand in an invitation, "Mrs. Shen, please come with me."
Qi Yueru agreed with a smile and left with the group.
After going around and around outside a house, when he was about to enter, Ba Yingshan stepped aside to make way for the door and solemnly said again: "Mrs. Shen, please forgive me."
Upon hearing this, Qi Yuerudun's expression changed drastically and he hurried into the house. Soon, her sobbing voice could be heard in the house.
People who entered one after another were filled with sadness when they saw Qi Yueru holding her son's body in her arms. It was originally a good thing to come to visit the prisoner, but who would have thought that it would end up being a suicide note? How unpredictable things are in the world!
After waiting for a while, Baying Shanfang said to the people behind him: "Parting between life and death is human nature. You all should step back and let her vent her anger first."
Everyone obeyed and left.
Without the outsiders, Bayingshan walked to Qi Yueru's side, and this time he sincerely advised: "My condolences."
Although his son and brother were dead, he felt a lot more relaxed. No matter how he went to deal with it last night, it really didn't cause him any trouble. Not only did he leave the bodies of his son and brother behind, but also the Universe Bag and Bone Dragon were left at the scene. He broke into a cold sweat after seeing the things at the scene and thinking about it. He felt that this woman was still sensible.
The grief-stricken Qi Yueru choked up and asked, "Have you found anything? Are there any clues about the murderer?"
Baying Shan glanced at the corpses lined up in a row, "Not counting the people who were buried after being poisoned in the mine, which is still being cleaned up, the five people including your brother were all beheaded. It is not easy to find the murderer based on this alone. However, after careful inspection of the wounds, we have a rough conclusion that all five of their heads should have been chopped off with a knife. Taken together, it is possible that it was done by the same knifeman. The traces at the scene also prove that there were not many people fighting."
"Knife?" Qi Yueru, who was hugging his son's body, suddenly raised his head, as if he remembered something, "Cut with a knife? I remembered, my son was in the eastJiuyuan seems to have an enemy who uses a knife. "
Bayingshan said helplessly: "I know who you are talking about. Not long after you brought in so many supplies, the people of Dongjiuyuan just got a sum of supplies. When you found me, I took care of the grudge between your son and that local snake.
To be honest, it probably wasn't that local snake who did it. Judging from the on-site investigation, your brother and the others used at least two third-grade immobilization charms but failed to immobilize each other. This is not something that the local snake in Dongjiuyuan can do.
Those people who died in the mine, don't say you don't know what happened. The people in Dongjiuyuan are basically gone. Based on the formation of your brother and the others, tell me, how many wrong medicines does that local snake have to take before he goes to kill your brother and the others? Do you think it's possible for those crazy poor guys to kill people and still keep the treasures? "
It made sense, Qi Yueru also fell into thinking, and then said with tears on his face: "Help me find out where they were when the incident happened. "
Ba Yingshan instinctively wanted to refuse, but when he saw her face full of tears and her eyes red from crying, he knew that this woman was emotionally unstable and didn't know what she would do if she got angry, so he could only nod silently and agreed, thinking that it would be just a formality.
However, the reality is that the result was somewhat unexpectedly smooth. The person he secretly arranged to go brought back reliable information that afternoon.
He also didn't expect that Shen Youkun actually had an eye liner near the target's lair. He happened to be discovered by the people he sent. After questioning, they tried everything. They could prove that the only two local snakes in Dongjiuyuan did not leave the lair when the incident happened. It was said that they had been staying in the lair to practice.
It stands to reason that with the witnesses, Qi Yueru should be relieved, but he has new doubts. He has enough merits, why didn't he leave the place of exile, and only two people are still hiding in that place where birds don't shit? Isn't it worthy of suspicion?
